title: potentilla subacaulis var. velutina
intro: Potentilla subacaulis var. velutina, commonly known as Velvet Cinquefoil, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Velvet Cinquefoil include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which help to soothe and protect the body from oxidative stress and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Velvet Cinquefoil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
